panels.title: Own-animal first-word rate through training (paper's 50-question metric)
panels.sub: P(first word = the student's animal), T=1, 100 samples × 50 questions per checkpoint. Dashed = base Qwen3-14B. The paper's Fig. 7 reaches ~100% for dolphin by 10k steps.

panels.title: LoRAcle: share of rollouts naming each animal
panels.sub: 5 questions × 16 rollouts per checkpoint and V convention. Outlined = the student's own animal.

panels.title: Our preference eval (5,000 samples per set)
panels.sub: Same eval as the v1 Behaviour tab, so the two are directly comparable.

panels.title: Training loss (log scale)
panels.sub: lr 1e-4 cosine, 5% warmup, batch 8, 10 epochs over every filtered row (~35k for dolphin). Loss stays ~0.1 through step 10k (v1 was already at ~1e-2 by then) and only falls to ~3e-4 in the last epochs.
